fusions.name: Unravelled Dose
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 9 arcane damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Unwarded Bite
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away with venom laced through raw arcana, dealing 30 arcane damage that rises to 1.4 times that at full reach and ignores resistance, with a 60% chance of [Mana Siphon] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Digestion
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Leaking Arcana
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, a venom bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
